sloka: सभार्यम् सम्प्रसुप्तम् तम् भ्रातरम् वीक्ष्य लक्ष्मणः ।कथयाम् आस सूताय रामस्य विविधान् गुणान् ॥२-४६-१५॥
transliteration: sabhāryam samprasuptam tam bhrātaram vīkṣya lakṣmaṇaḥ ।kathayām āsa sūtāya rāmasya vividhān guṇān ॥2-46-15॥

translations.english: Having seen that his brother along with his wife had fallen asleep, Lakshmana narrated the many virtues of Rama to Sumantra.
